cohort: The study included 292 women who delivered after 37 weeks of gestation between January 2021 and December 2022, excluding those with premature birth, scheduled cesarean delivery, or pregnancy complications.
finding: Goshakusan administration after 37 weeks of gestation did not decrease delivery time or the cesarean section rate, but instead led to a significantly later birth date.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in the mode of delivery between the goshakusan and control groups.
